scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Authenticated resource bootstrap created two server-owned workspaces, four ordered lists, and exactly 100 tasks.
Independent native Alice and Bob sessions each read exactly 100 workspace-authorized tasks.
Mallory received exact permission denials for both snapshot query and live subscription, with zero retained rows.
Create, edit, complete, reopen, reorder, and delete settled authoritatively and restored the fixture to 100 tasks.
Bob received Alice’s committed edit over the durable WebSocket stream without polling or refresh.

scenarioResults.note: The shipped shared-workspace query is membership-gated; v1 refuses retained role-gated results and the React surface is Online-class.
The JS membership-protected mutations are not locally runnable; no durable outbox is exposed through the React Online surface.
Reconnect re-establishes an authoritative online view, but there was no native queued work to settle.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: One concurrent stale baseline committed; the reservation loser was retried whole and received SNAPBACK_MUTATION_CONFLICT.
One atomic reorder committed, the stale peer conflicted, and authority retained one unique 0-through-24 order.
Bearer removal blanked all rows and blocked future delivery, while also surfacing a redundant-unsubscribe lifecycle diagnostic.
Bob’s self-removal denied a fresh read, but the established requireRole-gated live query retained 100 protected rows instead of blanking.
scenarioResults.note: A declared membership delete denied fresh reads but did not blank the established requireRole-gated JS live query before a future protected write.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Two warmups and seven raw samples cover read, write, second-client delivery, fresh subscription, and production build.
Exact cleanup removed the SQLite target plus source and built bearer carriers, then proved all three absent.

actor-authority.reason: Three distinct native principals were tested positively, negatively, after logout, and after membership removal.

transaction-conflict.reason: Explicit stale read sets proved both the reservation retry boundary and final durable mutation conflict.

transport.reason: Direct stream handles and an independent browser surface proved native push without polling fallback.

offline-reconnect.reason: The server was fully stopped; cold query and mutation both failed, and restart proved authoritative state had no queued create.

settlement.reason: Online mutation receipts were captured, but native offline settlement is a measured GAP.
